desc: Parse the input and construct an adjacency list representing the graph of XOR constraints.
Iterate through all vertices, launching a BFS for each unvisited vertex to explore its connected component.
During BFS, assign relative values using XOR propagation and immediately check for consistency on back-edges.
After processing a component, compute the optimal base value by counting set bits at each position and choosing the value that minimizes the total sum.
Apply the optimal base value to reconstruct the final sequence for the component and print the result or `-1` if contradictions arise.
